phases.title: Physical scientific environment qualification
phases.objective: Qualify the actual Windows workstation, WSL2 runtime, GPU, storage, recovery behaviour, antivirus compatibility and instrument-connected site where applicable.
phases.software_automation: System probe, disk/RAM/GPU inventory, large-file integrity, recovery probe, immutable report and target-machine boundary checks.
external_evidence_required: Instrument/site IQ-OQ-PQ and calibration records where applicable
phases.completion_rule: Every required physical-machine, GPU, site and instrument control must pass on the actual target environment.

phases.title: Specialist engine installation and qualification
phases.objective: Install and qualify every module-required scientific engine with pinned version, licence, executable hash and golden-fixture smoke test.
phases.software_automation: Step 170 WSL2/micromamba provisioning, manual-provider intake, version capture, executable SHA-256, smoke tests and registry updates.
phases.completion_rule: All engines required by the module must be qualified in the Step 170 registry.

phases.title: Production reference database qualification
phases.objective: Acquire official production reference releases and verify release identity, licence, provider checksum, local SHA-256, schema, indexes and scientific review.
phases.software_automation: Resumable download/import, checksum verification, licence gates, schema/index validation, rollback and release lifecycle registry.
phases.completion_rule: All references required by the module must be qualified in the Step 170 registry.

phases.title: Authentic task-specific models and real cohorts
phases.objective: Qualify task-matched model weights and real public, institutional or assay cohorts without synthetic or wrong-domain substitution.
phases.software_automation: Step 171 model-card, cohort, feature-schema, environment-lock, licence and cryptographic artifact verification.
external_evidence_required: Model card, training logs and environment lock
phases.completion_rule: Applicable modules require both a full task-specific domain model and a real public/official cohort; non-model modules are not applicable.

phases.title: Independent locked benchmark validation
phases.objective: Run a pre-specified, checksum-locked and leakage-controlled evaluation on an untouched external site, temporal or study holdout.
phases.software_automation: Locked split manifests, per-sample prediction export, calibration, uncertainty, subgroup, applicability-domain and baseline comparison checks.
phases.completion_rule: Applicable model modules must pass every Step 171 benchmark control and independent external-site validation.

phases.title: Wet-lab, prospective and orthogonal confirmation
phases.objective: Confirm applicable module outputs using frozen protocols, blinded prospective execution, independent sites and orthogonal assays.
phases.software_automation: Step 172 evidence workspaces, hash-bound manifests, batch/control checks, protocol freeze, blinded outcome reconciliation and fail-closed evaluation.
phases.completion_rule: Every confirmation axis required by the module profile must be complete with verified artifacts.

phases.title: Independent expert sign-off
phases.objective: Obtain qualified independent domain and QA review with conflict disclosure and cryptographically verifiable signatures.
phases.software_automation: Credential, conflict, review, public-key and detached-signature verification using SHA-256/OpenSSL.
phases.completion_rule: The Step 172 expert-signoff gate must meet the module minimum with cryptographically verified independent approvals.

phases.title: Qualified real-world operating history
phases.objective: Record enough genuine module runs, incidents, downtime, drift, recovery and corrective actions to demonstrate sustained operation.
phases.software_automation: Append-only run ledger, incident/CAPA templates, drift review and immutable history report verification.
phases.completion_rule: The module-specific minimum operating-run count, drift review and critical-incident controls must pass.

phases.title: Formal controlled-release review
phases.objective: Approve the exact evidence snapshot through an independent QA, domain-expert and product-owner release committee.
phases.software_automation: Quorum, intended-use, prohibited-use, residual-risk, signed decision, rollback and monitoring-plan verification.
phases.completion_rule: Formal release review and every upstream required gate must pass; averaging cannot override a failed gate.
